description: This file contains helper classes and functions for Android debugging tools, including argument parsing, process management, gdbserver control, and executable file handling.

classes.name: ArgumentParser
classes.description: A subclass of argparse.ArgumentParser that adds Android device selection options.

methods.name: parse_args
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and determines the connected device.

methods.name: get_processes
methods.description: Returns a dictionary mapping process names to their PIDs on the device.

methods.name: parse_ps_output
methods.description: Parses the output of the ps command to extract process info.

methods.name: get_pids
methods.description: Retrieves PIDs for a given process name.

methods.name: start_gdbserver
methods.description: Starts gdbserver on the device, attaches or runs commands, and forwards ports.

methods.name: get_uid
methods.description: Gets the UID that adbd runs as.

methods.name: forward_gdbserver_port
methods.description: Forwards a local TCP port to a remote port via adb.

methods.name: find_file
methods.description: Finds an executable file on the device, downloading if necessary.

methods.name: find_executable_path
methods.description: Finds the absolute path of an executable by name on the device.

methods.name: find_binary
methods.description: Finds the executable file for a process ID.

methods.name: get_binary_arch
methods.description: Determines the architecture of a binary ELF file.

methods.name: get_binary_interp
methods.description: Retrieves the program interpreter path from a binary.

methods.name: start_gdb
methods.description: Starts GDB or LLDB with specified commands and flags.
